note: Foreign stems that take an Uzbek suffix. These keep U+2019 (’) instead of being rewritten to U+02BB or U+02BC — the stem is not an Uzbek word, so neither Uzbek apostrophe applies. Matched against the whole word before the apostrophe, case-insensitively: 'hero' matches hero'dan, not superhero'dan. Add a stem here the first time it is written, not after it has shipped wrong.
